user.title: Set up HA Doctor
user.description: Check for offline devices and missing links in automations and scripts. HA Doctor groups findings in Repairs. Open Configure on the integration to review each finding or change your preferences.

abort.already_configured: HA Doctor is already set up.

unavailable.title: {entity} has been unavailable for at least {minutes} minutes
unavailable.description: Home Assistant has lost contact with `{entity}`. Open its device page to see whether other entities on the same device are affected. Check the device's power, connection, and integration status. A sleeping or intentionally disconnected device may be expected.

missing.title: {source} refers to a missing entity
missing.description: Home Assistant cannot find `{target}`, which is referenced by `{source}`. Open the automation or script and look for this entity ID. Check whether the target was renamed, removed, or has yet to load before selecting a replacement.

unavailable_summary.title: Offline entities ({count})
unavailable_summary.description:
Some entities have been offline longer than your chosen threshold. Open Configure, then Review offline entities to see their names and troubleshooting steps.

[Open HA Doctor](/config/integrations/integration/ha_doctor)

missing_summary.title: Missing references ({count})
missing_summary.description:
An automation or script points to an entity Home Assistant cannot find. Open Configure, then Review missing references to see each source and its missing target.

[Open HA Doctor](/config/integrations/integration/ha_doctor)

init.title: Home health overview
init.description:
**{offline}** offline entities · **{missing}** missing references

Choose a list to see what needs attention and where to look first.

waiting.title: Waiting for a scan
waiting.description: HA Doctor needs a successful scan to show current findings. If Home Assistant just started, check again in a moment.

missing.title: Missing references

unavailable.title: Offline entities

unavailable_clear.title: Offline entities
unavailable_clear.description: The latest scan found no entities that have been offline long enough to report.

missing_clear.title: Missing references
missing_clear.description: The latest scan found no missing entity IDs in the automations and scripts it checked.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Save to apply these preferences and scan again.

data.individual: Show a separate Repairs notice for each finding

data_description.threshold: Continuous time offline. A brief recovery restarts the timer.
data_description.interval: How often HA Doctor checks for new and resolved findings.
data_description.excluded: Choose entities that are normally offline, such as a seasonal plug. Missing references are checked separately.
data_description.individual: Off by default. Turn this on if you want to dismiss findings individually. Large installations can produce many notices.

error.whole_minutes: Enter whole minutes for both time settings.
